title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
text: American Express is introducing a new framework designed to ensure AI agents only make purchases their users have authorized, potentially preventing costly mistakes and disputes as AI-powered shopping grows.

title: Just 5 years in, interactive chatbot platform Character.AI files for bankruptcy
text: The startup will sell some of its assets to Disney for $20 million.

title: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
text: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.

title: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data
text: A Silicon Valley startup that uses weather balloons and AI to predict the weather won a U.S. military contract worth almost $50 million.

title: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation
text: Microsoft president Brad Smith calls for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines have more oversight than AI companies.

title: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes
